name: password-strength
title: Password Strength
description: Watch the strength indicator as you type
useCases: At signup, a user watches the local strength estimate change as they type a new password.
In a password change form, a user improves the candidate before submitting. The app applies its own policy when saving.
task: Watch the strength indicator as you type
behavior: onChange receives the entered password. The meter gives local strength feedback. Apply registration requirements on form submission.
